title: Model-usage archetypes and regional fallback cost projections
creator: Priya Shah
description: Objective: produce a defensible set of customer-facing archetypes for model usage (e.g., embedding-heavy search, low-latency chat, batch summarization) and for each archetype deliver a regional fallback plan with cost/latency trade-offs and suggested model variants. Scope: US/EU/APAC regions, hosted vs dedicated vs private deployment modes, quantized vs full-precision variants. Deliverables: 1) archetype catalog with representative workloads and token distributions; 2) regional fallback matrix mapping primary model -> 3 fallback candidates with estimated per-token cost and median p50 latency; 3) playbook for automated routing rules and guardrails (SLO thresholds, quality regression triggers); 4) slide pack for GTM and engineering handoff. Why: customers frequently ask for concrete guidance on which model variants to prefer in constrained regions and how to balance cost vs latency while preserving quality. This reduces sales friction and informs Dedicated capacity planning.
acceptance_criteria: Archetype catalog (CSV + short descriptions) uploaded to Drive and linked
Fallback matrix produced with cost & latency estimates for US/EU/APAC and a documented method for calculations
Quality gating heuristics (example prompts + expected metric bands) documented
Engineering sign-off on feasibility of automated routing playbook and estimated implementation effort
GTM slide deck prepared and reviewed by Growth (>=1 review comment resolved)
